description: Edit the details of a listing you own (PATCH /api/agent/listing/{slug}). Only the fields you pass are changed. Slug, outbound link tier and paid status are admin-managed. Copy must be neutral — ranking language (best, top, leading, …) is rejected with 422.

categories.description: Category slugs — call list_categories; replaces the existing set

description.description: Neutral listing copy (min 20 chars; ranking language is rejected)

features.description: Structured feature list — replaces the existing one

pricing.description: Starting price (USD); pass null to clear it

slug.description: Slug of a listing you own (from submit_tool / get_submission)

website.description: Canonical http(s) URL of the tool

name: update_listing
